messages:
maria_finance: Quick preflight for PriceWave v3 cutover tomorrow. New price sheet (v3) introduces tiered micro-pricing and a phased-grandfathering rule. Need a final ledger->invoice parity check, vendor fee normalization, and approval for customer comms. TL;DR: do not flip cohort B to live until finance + ops + sales signoff.

sam_billing: uploading sample invoice rows now. what's our parity tolerance for the experiment? previous threshold was $0.50/account/day; finance wants to tighten for this cohort?

maria_finance: target tolerance: <$0.25/account/day aggregated across cohort. individual account outreach trigger: delta > $75. If we exceed either, hold the toggle.

maria_finance: sample rows (excerpt):
```
acct,inv,period,usage,unit_price,calc_amount,invoice_amount
acct_4004,inv_a100,2026-03-01_2026-03-31,432100,0.0007,302.47,302.47
acct_5005,inv_a101,2026-03-01_2026-03-31,10,0.08,0.80,0.8
acct_6006,inv_a102,2026-03-01_2026-03-31,999999,0.0007,699.9993,700.00
```

ben_ops: noted. two infra asks: 1) we need a deploy window for the billing ingest patch (will do staging->prod if tests pass), 2) ops wants a rollback plan if invoice generation fails for >1% of cohort. recommended window: 30min low-traffic early-morning.

nina_growth: and a reminder on legacy credits: v3 should apply `phase_pct` to legacy credits, not overwrite them. we planned a 3-cycle taper (100% -> 66% -> 33% -> 0). confirm mapping key is `phase_pct`.

sam_billing: I ran diff on a 10k-sample between ledger and invoice lines, found two systematic issues: vendor_fee units inconsistent (some rows cents, some dollars) and a rounding strategy mismatch for large usages (we used round-half-up in invoice generator, ledger uses bankers).

maria_finance: which vendors? can you paste sample SQL to identify affected rows?

sam_billing: ```sql
SELECT vendor, COUNT(*) AS rows, AVG(invoice_amount - calc_amount) AS avg_delta
FROM pricewave_ingest
WHERE vendor IN ('edge-accelerate','fast-store')
GROUP BY vendor;
```
found vendor_fee unit mismatch for edge-accelerate.

billing-bot: Snapshot saved: s3://redwood-billing/pricewave/v3/snap-2026-03-11T05-00Z/ledger.csv (md5: abc123)

ben_ops: ops will hotfix the transformer to normalize vendor_fee -> cents for listed vendors. patch: multiply vendor_fee by 100 when currency_unit = 'dollars' AND vendor IN (...). will deploy to staging first. timeline ~25-35m.

maria_finance: once patch is in staging run the reconcile and post cohort-level summary. sam, can you produce an aggregated delta CSV with these columns: account_id,cohort,delta_cents,delta_pct,notify_flag? notify_flag = delta_cents > 7500 OR delta_pct > 0.02.

sam_billing: yup. will run full reconcile post-patch and post the CSV. aiming for final report by 06:30 PT.

aj_sales: I'll prep outreach language. proposed policy: automatic one-time billing credit for deltas > $100; personalized outreach for 75-100 band. Also need a list of top-10 customers by ARR for manual review.

nina_growth: +1. also request to include a short FAQ: "Why did my credits change?" explaining 3-cycle phased-grandfathering.

maria_finance: ops: please do not flip cohort B until I post "finance signoff" in this thread. Ben, confirm you will hold the toggle.

sam_billing: small note: changing round-half-up -> bankers affects revenue recognition slightly. finance ok?

maria_finance: bankers rounding is preferred to align with ledger preprocessor. will note impact in the close-of-month report.

ben_ops: confirmed. Holding cohort B toggle until explicit finance+sales signoff. Will run staging pass now.

billing-bot: Deploy started: pricewave-ingest-transformer v1.7.2 -> staging (build 5478).

sam_billing: found one more oddity: promo inheritance for legacy SKUs was being applied twice when `phase_pct` is present and `default_credit` also exists. fix is to set precedence: if phase_pct IS NOT NULL -> use phased value, else default_credit. I'll add a validation rule to the invoice generator.

maria_finance: perfect. update mapping doc and push the new mapping CSV to the shared drive, then I'll run a dry invoice generation.

aj_sales: I want the outreach draft before final signoff. maria, can you tag me when you post the top_20.csv?

maria_finance: will do. expected next updates: 1) ben reports staging deploy success, 2) sam posts delta CSV, 3) maria posts top_20 + outreach draft. if all green we'll aim to flip at 08:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
